text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day too, after finishing training 
with Yukino Bijin, we were just about to 
head back, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what she was looking at, I 
followed her gaze, and saw that she seemed 
to be watching the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if everyone is having dinner 
right about now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no, no! I'm gonna do my best right 
here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've got a favor to ask ya...! 
Please let me train just a little bit 
more!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna live up to everyone back home who 
cheered for me and sent me off!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I want to perform so well that talk about 
me brightens up the dinner table at 
night!"
choice_data_list: Okay, let's give it one more push!

If you push yourself too hard, it'll all 
be for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Thank ya kindly! Alright, keep your eyes 
on me, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Yukino Bijin trained hard, as 
if trying to shake off her worries.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true. They do say 'a healthy 
horse is a great Umamusume,' after all!
choice_data_list:
Let's get plenty of rest so we can do our 
best tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Got it! I'll get plenty of rest 
to prepare for tomorrow, yes I will!
